# Other people's marks

The two files here are not ours. They are the GitHub and Ko-fi marks,
used in the settings window to link to the repository and to the
author's Ko-fi page — which is what they are for.

They come from [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org), whose own work
is CC0; the marks themselves belong to GitHub, Inc. and Ko-fi Labs,
Inc. respectively, and are used here to point at those services and
nothing else. The only change is a white fill, since the settings
window is dark and Qt's SVG renderer does not inherit a colour.

Nothing else under `assets/` is third-party: see the licence note in
the README.
